CATALOG_ARCHIVE_INVALID: input is not a ZIP archive
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_EXPANSION_RATIO_EXCEEDED: entry expands by more than 100 to 1
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_PATH_INVALID: entry is absolute, traversing, backslashed, or contains NUL
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_PATH_DUPLICATE: two entries have the same normalized path
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN: entry has a symbolic-link Unix mode
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_ENCRYPTION_FORBIDDEN: entry has the encrypted general-purpose bit
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_DOCUMENT_MALFORMED: manifest or resource detail cannot be decoded
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_DEPENDENCY_PATH_INVALID: an entry under dependencies/ is not dependencies/{registry}/{namespace}/{catalogKey}/{releaseVersion}.zip with each segment valid
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_DEPENDENCY_NESTED: a carried release itself contains dependencies/
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_DEPENDENCY_IDENTITY_MISM: a carried release's manifest names another catalog or release than its path
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_DEPENDENCY_FINGERPRINT_M: a carried release does not match the releaseFingerprint of a pin that reaches it
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_DEPENDENCY_UNREFERENCED: a carried release no pin reaches, directly or through a carried release
CATALOG_ARCHIVE_DEPENDENCY_CONFLICT: two reachable pins name different releases of one catalog
